data.title: Finding the Area of Composite Polygons
data.description: Practice decomposing irregular rectilinear figures into smaller rectangles to calculate their total area.

challenges.narration: A deck wrapping a corner is shaped like this figure.
challenges.instruction: Split the figure into rectangles, find each area, then add them up.
challenges.hint: Break the L-shape into two rectangles. Find length × width for each piece, then add the two areas.
